miniProject.title: Direct preference optimization with controlled comparisons
miniProject.brief: Derive and test DPO from scratch in `policylab`, then separate real preference gains from scoring, reference and selection effects. The checked loss, baselines and ledgers feed online-policy training and the capstone evidence pack.
steps: Derive the KL-regularized optimum and DPO loss in `llm/` from policy ratios, verify the same-prompt reward-shift oracle against hand algebra, list preference and reference assumptions, and pass the free TensorTonic KL-regularized policy objective cases.

Build completion scoring in `llm/` with shifted masks and explicit EOS, padding, empty and truncation rules, show token evidence for each policy-reference pair, and pass the free TensorTonic DPO loss and canonical-pair cases plus your own gradient and swap tests.

Bind reference scores to checkpoint, tokenizer, template and mask identity in `schema/`, inject a deliberate reference-drift failure, audit support gaps, and differential-test loss and gradients against the pinned RLHF Book `DPOLoss` with mask, sign and reference regressions in `tests/`.

Compare small SFT, DPO and no-reference runs on shared data in `llm/`, separating score normalization from reference removal, then contrast DPO with IPO on synthetic CPU preferences under noise and reuse with smoothed-loss stationary-point checks.

Run a bounded sensitivity study over regularization, epochs, reuse or label noise, report held-out prompt and annotator slices with raw generations, and retain one proxy-versus-behavior failure where pair accuracy rises while independent behavior falls.

Compare DPO with SFT, rejection and best-of-N controls from a CPU text policy under a stated budget, keep ledgers in `ledger/`, and defend the frozen task, safety and style verdict with negative evidence across seeds, moving to a decoder only if your GPU fits it.
deliverables: The `llm/` DPO package with derivation, scoring oracles and regression tests.
Baseline, variant and sensitivity tables with raw generations and failures.
Compute and data ledgers with the frozen evaluation and defended claim.

checks.name: TensorTonic: Score a KL-Regularized Policy Batch
checks.note: Pass all three public cases before trusting the optimum derivation.

checks.name: TensorTonic: Implement the DPO Loss
checks.note: Pass positive, mixed and zero-margin cases; add extreme-logit tests.

checks.name: TensorTonic: Canonicalize Pairwise Preference Data
checks.note: Pass ranking and order cases; add tie and duplicate handling.

checks.name: RLHF Book DPOLoss at pinned commit
checks.note: Differential-test loss and gradients on fixed log probabilities.

rubric.pass: The shift oracle matches hand algebra and every preference and reference assumption is listed.
rubric.strong: A cross-prompt comparison is shown to break cancellation with a failing test.

rubric.pass: Masks, lengths, templates and truncation pass oracles with token evidence and gradient checks.
rubric.strong: A means-versus-sums pair flips the margin and the test names the changed objective.

rubric.pass: Baselines, IPO comparison and sensitivity slices separate objective, data and evaluator effects.
rubric.strong: A retained failure shows pair gains with flat or falling behavior and its cause.

rubric.pass: Budgets, candidates, calls and seeds reconcile from raw records with negative evidence kept.
rubric.strong: An independent rerun rebuilds every table from raw records alone.
